purpose: Emphasize that even a minimal thought or possibility is extreme.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
V dictionary + だに; Vます stem / N + だにしない
Even imagining the damage is frightening.
He did not stir even at the deafening noise.
I never even dreamed the plan would fail.
formation: V dictionary + だに; Vます stem / N + だにしない
restrictions: Common fixed combinations include 想像するだに and 微動だにしない.
mistake: Do not substitute it casually for every everyday さえ.
